name: Buffalos in the tall-grass prairie in Oklahoma, growling, grunting, sniffing and eating some food
description:
At the end of the day, the buffalos came to eat some food the worker of the park gave to them with his truck. The bisons came really close to us.

Sound recorded by a MS setup Schoeps CCM41+CCM8
Sound Devices 788T recorder with CL8
MS is encoded in STEREO Left-Right
Sound File in 96khz
recorded in may 2013 in the Tallgrass Prairie Reserve close to Pawhuska, Oklahoma (USA).
Sound Reference: @CD130510T012

The same sound on SOUND CLOUD https://soundcloud.com/felixblume/buffalos

more sounds on www.felixblume.com

Please rate or comment the sound if you like it!
